pronunciation: ir · rek · un · SY · luh · bul
definition: Impossible to combine because the differences are too great.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: It is likely that these occupations are irreconcilable with home enjoyment…
example_sentence: The band split over irreconcilable musical differences.
